findings.claim: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] unguarded and casts to PropertyDeclarationSyntax. Its doc comment claims it returns null for metadata properties, but it would throw IndexOutOfRangeException. A metadata-only property of a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly reaches the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path and crashes the analyzer or generator. This is a robustness failure: the exception causes CS8785/AD0001 and the generator contributes no output, so protections from the generated resolver are lost. It is not a direct deserialization hole.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the REQ-2283 repro (closed generic struct Item<int> from a referenced assembly, with a member whose Key attribute has null int and string keys) through the generator and analyzer tests. Assert no IndexOutOfRangeException and no CS8785/AD0001. Alternatively, mutate the helper to use FirstOrDefault() and check whether the test fails.
